grammar.summary: 本课学习表"青春期"的语义群与 fail to do 结构。

points.title: fail to do 表"未能"
points.explanation: Parents fail to understand their children. fail to = 未能做到，否定含义的肯定形式。

examples.en: They fail to realize how things have changed.
examples.cn: 他们没有意识到时代已经变了。

points.title: 表"平等对待"的 on equal terms
points.explanation: to be on equal terms with adults = 与成人平等相处，terms 表关系。

examples.en: The adolescent wants to be on equal terms with adults.
examples.cn: 青少年希望与成年人平起平坐。
